entries.title: Joshua 8:1
segments: When sin is heartily put away, and men are disposed to hear and obey God, there is no reason to be discouraged, or to fear to undertake any service to which he calls them.

entries.title: Joshua 8:2
segments: By coveting what does not belong to them, and making haste to be rich, men often bring themselves to an untimely end; when, had they waited with patience and faithfully done their duty, they would in due time have had an abundance and been able to enjoy it.

entries.title: Joshua 8:4
segments: Ye shall lie in wait; from
, it seems probable that only five thousand of these were actually placed in ambush between Bethel and Ai.

entries.title: Joshua 8:8
segments: If men would secure the blessings of the Lord, they must not shrink from any service to which he calls them.

entries.title: Joshua 8:12
segments: About five thousand; see note to

entries.title: Joshua 8:13
segments: To accomplish things which God has foretold, and which are beforehand certain, it is as needful to use means as it would be if they were not foretold, or their accomplishment depended wholly upon human efforts.

entries.title: Joshua 8:16
segments: All the people; the men of war.

entries.title: Joshua 8:17
segments: When the measure of a people's iniquity is full, they are given up, in hardness of heart and blindness of mind, to pursue a course which ends in their ruin.

entries.title: Joshua 8:19
segments: Set the city on fire; they began the work of burning the city, but its destruction was not completed till after Joshua and the men of war with him entered the city, spoiled it, and slew all its inhabitants.

entries.title: Joshua 8:25
segments: In punishing men for their sins, God uses such instruments as he sees best, and it was no more wrong for him to destroy the men of Ai by the hand of the Israelites, than it would have been to destroy them by pestilence, famine, or an earthquake.

entries.title: Joshua 8:29
segments: Men of great influence, who have been leaders in transgression, will be distinguished in their punishment, and the righteous Judge will award to all who persevere in iniquity according to their works.

entries.title: Joshua 8:30
segments: We should ever feel and acknowledge that all our blessings come through the atonement of Christ, and should engage in nothing which will unfit us to acknowledge and adore him.

entries.title: Joshua 8:34
segments: All the words of the law;

entries.title: Joshua 8:35
segments: The minds of all classes of people should be habitually directed to the will of God as revealed in the Scriptures, and all suitable means be perseveringly used to lead them to obey it.
